about: The secreta of the formulary “Nativity of the Blessed Virgin Mary” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: May the humanity of Your only-begotten Son help us, O Lord, as He, Who, born of a virgin did not lessen but consecrated the purity of His mother, so, on the festival of her Nativity may Jesus Christ, our Lord, free us from our sins and render our sacrifice acceptable to You. Who livest and reignest with God the Father in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
